failure_modes: Compiled C1 schedule produces no change in realized per-node coordinate traces relative to C2, so the edit did not change execution and must be reported as ineffective.
Endpoint affinity does not improve relative to the constant-curvature control C2, so the stage-dependent hypothesis is not supported even if traces differ.

Gradient cancellation between the early robust and late baseline curvature components yields a near-zero combined endpoint VJP, indistinguishable from an unsuitable target without gradient-direction and delivered-dose checks.
A changing scalar reward value is mistaken for changed injection; realized-dose auditing is required because equal sum(dt*w) is only a ratio budget.
Coordinate trace differences are read as affinity benefit; no decoded final affinity labels are present, so selection preference and coordinate trends cannot be equated with measured final benefit.
Strain and structural validity are not separately verified; changed chemical graphs are permitted but coordinate similarity alone does not establish improved affinity.
rationale: H001 proposes testing registered stage-dependent curvature at fixed dose_factors=1 because the landmark_00_soft_mass curve changes sign and slope within the observed window; H002 supplies the constant-curvature control (C2) against which any time-varying recipe must show a measurable trace difference. The delivered curve handle Eef4385e476674774 and its trend row E2e106e083189d150 show an oscillatory, non-monotone profile with opposing endpoint rate z-scores and no accepted polynomial, so a single constant delta may not match the early-versus-late contrast. C1_robust_to_base is the registered reward-route recipe that applies the larger delta early and relaxes toward baseline curvature later, matching the observed early-versus-late contrast while holding dose at 1 and teachers fixed. C2_constant_curvature is retained as the required control, and C3 is the opposite-timing control; the edit is justified only if C1 produces a realized per-node coordinate trace change distinct from C2. The objective remains final predicted target affinity primary with coordinate control only (Eaa4bda02c9a2c3a1), and the learning window and score clocks are 0.0-0.5 (E0857891f4effbfe1).
